(a) bears are attracted to trains in Banff National park, (b) this attraction is mediated by the availability of food, and (c) this attraction is learned by individual bears.
(i) grizzly bears are attracted to the landscape around rail lines, and (ii) this attraction can be mitigated by a simple warning device that signals trains to approaching bears.
